MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "25 Classical Favorites feels like a natural next choice after my recent relaxing classical collection because I want musical performances suitable for calm, everyday listening.",
    "Simon & Garfunkel The Best Of appeals to my interest in melodic vocals, while The Most Soothing Lullabies In The Universe connects with my desire for gentle listening, though neither is my first choice today."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "That's Christmas To Me and Home for Christmas connect with earlier listening, but my past enjoyment of holiday music does not mean I want seasonal songs now.",
    "The nature sounds collection fits relaxation broadly, but I want music rather than environmental sounds; PTX, Vol. III also feels less suited to my current interest in classical music or theatrical vocals.",
    "Together, Something Beautiful, and Hope do not give me enough information to connect them confidently with the musical qualities I enjoy."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My earlier Christmas listening seems to carry too much weight when my current interest is everyday listening.",
    "Wanting something relaxing seems to have been interpreted too broadly, treating environmental sounds, lullabies, and classical performances as equally appealing."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My most recent interest in relaxing classical music matters more to today's choice than my older seasonal listening.",
    "I care about how the relaxation is achieved: melodic musical performances appeal more than nature sounds, and a general classical collection appeals more than lullabies.",
    "For unfamiliar albums, knowing the artist or musical content would help me decide whether they match my interest in classical music and expressive vocals."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my interest in gentle music and melodic vocals, but gave too much weight to older holiday listening and too little to my current preference for relaxing classical performances."
}
